summary: Q1 2026 earnings reported May 6, 2026: revenue $464.4M (+30.8% YoY, vs $449.37M est), adj EPS $0.16 (vs $0.15 est), system SSS +8.3%. Raised FY2026 guidance: revenue $2.05B-$2.08B, adj EBITDA $370M-$380M, 185+ new shops. Risk overhang: McDonald's expanding McCafe beverages (refreshers, energy drinks, Red Bull-based energy launching Aug 2026) competing with Dutch Bros Rebel energy drinks. UBS counters competitor concerns are overblown.
